pairs.target: liǎngtiān hòu de liànxí , lín kē xiān bǎ nà zhī ǎidèng bānjìn báixiàn , dèng miàncháo shàng , xiàng yíliàng shǎo le lúnzi de chē .
pairs.english: At practice two days later, Lin Ke first moved that low stool inside the white lines, its seat facing up like a cart missing its wheels.
pairs.hanzi: 两天后的练习，林珂先把那只矮凳搬进白线，凳面朝上，像一辆少了轮子的车。

pairs.target: tā zhào shàng huí shuō de , xuǎn le kàoqiáng yícè , yāo shàng méiyǒu jì diàn , sòng yuǎn jiāng yíkuài bù dā zài dèng jiǎo , jiào tāmen jīnrì rèn zhè yíchù .
pairs.english: Following the plan stated last time, she chose the side by the wall, with no pad tied at her waist; Song Yuan draped a piece of cloth over the stool's corner and told them to mark this spot today.
pairs.hanzi: 她照上回说的，选了靠墙一侧，腰上没有系垫，宋远将一块布搭在凳角，叫他们今日认这一处。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi xiān wèn shìbushì pèngdào bù jiùsuàn , tā shuō hái dé dài de zǒu , bùrán zìjǐ yì lā , huò yě yào suàn bèi rén tōu le .
pairs.english: Tavi first asked whether touching the cloth counted; she said they also had to carry it away, otherwise if she herself pulled once the cargo would count as stolen too.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维先问是不是碰到布就算，她说还得带得走，不然自己一拉，货也要算被人偷了。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn jiāng bù de yìjiǎo jì sōng , shì guò zhǐ xū qīngqīng yì tí biàn néng kāi , méi ràng tāmen wèile yìzhī jié zài bǎ zhěngzhāng dèngzi xiānfān .
pairs.english: Song Yuan tied one corner of the cloth loosely, testing that only a gentle lift would release it; he did not let them overturn the whole stool again over a knot.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远将布的一角系松，试过只须轻轻一提便能开，没让他们为了一只结再把整张凳子掀翻。

pairs.target: tā gěi liǎng rén kàn mùbàng shàng de ruǎnbù tóu , shuō réng zhǐ zǒu , bùzhǔn qiǎngkuài , xiān pèng rén huò pèng dèng dōu yàoshuō qīngchǔ , shuí hǎntíng jiù tíng .
pairs.english: He showed both of them the soft cloth tip on the wooden stick, saying they were still only to walk, with no race for speed; they must clearly state whether they would touch a person or the stool first, and stop whenever anyone called a halt.
pairs.hanzi: 他给两人看木棒上的软布头，说仍只走，不准抢快，先碰人或碰凳都要说清楚，谁喊停就停。

pairs.target: lín kē ná le pǔtōng de hùjù zhàn dào dèng biān , yòujiān tiējìn qiáng , duǎnbàng liúgěi tǎ wéi , tā méiyǒu bǎi chū shàng huí jìngōng shí nà fù yàngzi .
pairs.english: Lin Ke took the ordinary protective gear and stood beside the stool, her right shoulder close to the wall; the short stick was left for Tavi, and she did not adopt that posture from last time's attack.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂拿了普通的护具站到凳边，右肩贴近墙，短棒留给塔维，她没有摆出上回进攻时那副样子。

pairs.target: tā yán báixiàn zǒujìn , xiān wǎng tā zuǒbiān shì , tā gēn le yì xiǎobù , hùjù héng zài bù qián , tā biàn xiǎng cóng lìngyícè shēn bàng .
pairs.english: He approached along the white line, first probing toward her left; she followed one small step, the guard across the cloth's front, and he then wanted to extend the stick from the other side.
pairs.hanzi: 他沿白线走近，先往她左边试，她跟了一小步，护具横在布前，他便想从另一侧伸棒。

pairs.target: lín kē méiyǒu zhuī bàng , tā tuìhuí dèng páng , jiào tā lái , tǎ wéi fǎnér tíng le yíxià , juéde tā xiàng zǎo zhīdào zìjǐ yào qù nǎér .
pairs.english: Lin Ke did not chase the stick; she stepped back beside the stool and told him to come, but Tavi paused briefly instead, feeling she seemed to know already where he himself wanted to go.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂没有追棒，她退回凳旁，叫他来，塔维反而停了一下，觉得她像早知道自己要去哪儿。

pairs.target: ménwài yǒurén jiào shuǐ dào le , tā yì fēnshén , lín kē biàn shuō jīnrì zìjǐ bù qǐng tā hē , tā ruò kǒukě , kěyǐ xiān bǎ bàng fàngxià .
pairs.english: Someone outside called that the water had arrived; as his attention wandered, Lin Ke said she herself would not invite him for a drink today, and if he was thirsty he could put the stick down first.
pairs.hanzi: 门外有人叫水到了，他一分神，林珂便说今日自己不请他喝，他若口渴，可以先把棒放下。

pairs.target: tā xiào zhe bǎ yǎnjīng shōuhuí , mànmàn jìn dào tā kěn ràngchū de dìfāng , hùjù pèng zhù bàngtóu shí , liǎnggè rén dōu méiyǒu jiālì .
pairs.english: Smiling, he brought his eyes back and slowly entered the space she was willing to yield; when the guard met the stick tip, neither of them added force.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑着把眼睛收回，慢慢进到她肯让出的地方，护具碰住棒头时，两个人都没有加力。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wǎng hòuchè bàng , tā de shǒu gēn le bànjié , jiǎo què liú zhe , bù jiǎo réng zài tā shēnhòu , tā zhǐnéng bǎ zhè yìhuí kōng zhe tuì wán .
pairs.english: Tavi withdrew the stick backward; her hand followed partway but her feet stayed, the cloth corner still behind her, and he could only finish this attempt empty-handed.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维往后撤棒，她的手跟了半截，脚却留着，布角仍在她身后，他只能把这一回空着退完。

pairs.target: lín kē cháo sòng yuǎn kàn , tā zhǐ jiào huànrén , méi tì tā jiāng méi bèi qǔ zǒu xiěchéng yǐhòu dōu shǒu de zhù .
pairs.english: Lin Ke looked toward Song Yuan; he only called for a swap, not writing the fact it had not been taken as proof that she could always defend it in future.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂朝宋远看，他只叫换人，没替她将没被取走写成以后都守得住。

alignment.english: the fact it had not been taken

pairs.target: lún dào tǎ wéi shí , tā jiāng hùjù ná de bǐ fāngcái gāo , xiǎng xiān hùzhù bù , yě xiǎng bié ràng bàng duān pèngdào zìjǐ de yāo .
pairs.english: When it was Tavi's turn, he held the protective gear higher than before, wanting first to guard the cloth and also wanting not to let the stick's end touch his own waist.
pairs.hanzi: 轮到塔维时，他将护具拿得比方才高，想先护住布，也想别让棒端碰到自己的腰。

pairs.target: lín kē cóng qiáng nà yícè lái , duǎnbàng shēn dào yíbàn biàn tíng zhe , wèn tā shìbushì yào bǎ zìjǐ jǐjìn dèngzi lǐ .
pairs.english: Lin Ke came from the wall side, extending the short stick halfway and then holding it there, asking him whether he wanted to squeeze himself into the stool.
pairs.hanzi: 林珂从墙那一侧来，短棒伸到一半便停着，问他是不是要把自己挤进凳子里。

pairs.target: tā dītóu cái kànjiàn xiǎotuǐ yǐ dǐngzhù dèng yán , ruò zài wǎnghòu ràng , dèngzi yě děi gēnzhe zǒu , bú xiàng yuànlǐ de báixiàn , cǎi guòqù hái liúzài yuánchù .
pairs.english: Only on looking down did he see his shin already pressed against the stool's edge; if he yielded backward again, the stool too would have to move with him, unlike the courtyard's white line that stayed in place even when stepped over.
pairs.hanzi: 他低头才看见小腿已顶住凳沿，若再往后让，凳子也得跟着走，不像院里的白线，踩过去还留在原处。

pairs.target: tā wǎng pángbiān nuó , hùjù líkāi dèng jiǎo , lín kē méi cháo tā yāo shàng pèng , bùtóu qīngqīng tiāoqǐ le sōng jié , dā zhe de bù huá dào dìshàng .
pairs.english: He moved aside and the guard left the stool's corner; Lin Ke did not touch toward his waist, the cloth tip gently lifting the loose knot, and the draped cloth slid to the ground.
pairs.hanzi: 他往旁边挪，护具离开凳角，林珂没朝他腰上碰，布头轻轻挑起了松结，搭着的布滑到地上。

pairs.target: " hái méi názǒu . "
pairs.english: “It's not taken away yet.”
pairs.hanzi: “还没拿走。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuōwán zìjǐ yě dūnxià , sòng yuǎn jiàotíng , lín kē de bàng xiān shōuhuí , liǎng rén shēn dào yíbàn de shǒu dōu liúzài xī qián .
pairs.english: After speaking Tavi himself crouched too; Song Yuan called a stop, Lin Ke's stick was withdrawn first, and the two students' half-extended hands both remained before their knees.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说完自己也蹲下，宋远叫停，林珂的棒先收回，两人伸到一半的手都留在膝前。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn wèn tā ruò zhǐgù dītóu qiǎng bù , fāngcái dǎng zài xiōngqián de dōngxī xiànzài qù le nǎlǐ , tā dītóu zhǎo , hùjù chuí dào zìjǐ xié páng .
pairs.english: Song Yuan asked him where the object previously blocking his chest had gone now, if he only cared about looking down to snatch the cloth; he looked down to find it, the protective gear hanging beside his own shoes.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远问他若只顾低头抢布，方才挡在胸前的东西现在去了哪里，他低头找，护具垂到自己鞋旁。

pairs.target: tā yǒudiǎn bùfú , bù quèshí hái zài dìshàng , lín kē yě méiyǒu nádào , què zhīdào zìjǐ dūnxià shí méi zài kàn tā .
pairs.english: He was a little unconvinced: the cloth truly was still on the ground and Lin Ke had not got it either; yet he knew that while he himself was crouching he had not looked at her again.
pairs.hanzi: 他有点不服，布确实还在地上，林珂也没有拿到，却知道自己蹲下时没再看她。

pairs.target: xiēxī shí lín kē ná bù cā dèng , shuō jiālǐ zhēn yǒu chē tíng zhe shí , pángbiān háiyǒu rén , zìjǐ bùnéng lǎo bǎ rén quán xiǎng chéng yào shēnshǒu lái qiǎng de .
pairs.english: During the break Lin Ke wiped the stool with the cloth, saying that when there really was a wagon standing at home there were people nearby too; she herself could not always think of all people as reaching to snatch things.
pairs.hanzi: 歇息时林珂拿布擦凳，说家里真有车停着时，旁边还有人，自己不能老把人全想成要伸手来抢的。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn nà yào zěnme kàn , tā shuō hái méi xiǎng hǎo , xiān bié ràng sòng yuǎn tīngjiàn , miǎnde xiàhuí ràng tā yě zhànjìnlái , tāmen jīnrì lián dèngzi hái méi shǒu míngbái .
pairs.english: Tavi asked how they should look at it then; she said she had not worked it out yet, and not to let Song Yuan hear for now, lest next time they let him stand in there too, since today they had not even worked out defending the stool.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问那要怎么看，她说还没想好，先别让宋远听见，免得下回让他也站进来，他们今日连凳子还没守明白。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn zài ménkǒu dàoshuǐ , shuō zìjǐ yǐjīng tīngjiàn le , lín kē jiāng bù fānguò yímiàn , zhuāngzuò fāngcái zhǐshì zài shuō dèng shàng yǒu shā .
pairs.english: Song Yuan poured water at the doorway and said he himself had already heard; Lin Ke turned the cloth over to another side, pretending that just now she had only been saying there was sand on the stool.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远在门口倒水，说自己已经听见了，林珂将布翻过一面，装作方才只是在说凳上有沙。

pairs.target: zài lái yìhuí qián , lín kē jiāng bù chóngxīn dā hǎo , sòng yuǎn shì guò sōng jié , tǎ wéi cái bǎ jiǎo cóng dèng biān nuókāi bànbù , gěi xīgài liú dìfāng , hùjù què méiyǒu jǔ dào zhēzhù lín kē de liǎn .
pairs.english: Before another attempt, Lin Ke draped the cloth again and Song Yuan tested the loose knot; only then did Tavi move his feet half a step away from the stool, leaving room for his knees, but not raising the guard to hide Lin Ke's face.
pairs.hanzi: 再来一回前，林珂将布重新搭好，宋远试过松结，塔维才把脚从凳边挪开半步，给膝盖留地方，护具却没有举到遮住林珂的脸。

pairs.target: tā shēn bàng lái , tā méi zhuī bàngtóu , zhǐ zài bù qián dǎng le yíxià , lín kē tíngzhù , yòu jiāng bàng mànmàn chōuhuí , liǎng rén dōu méi qiǎng zhe shuō shuí chéng le .
pairs.english: She extended the stick toward him; he did not chase the tip, only blocked once in front of the cloth; Lin Ke stopped, then slowly drew the stick back, and neither of them hurried to say who had succeeded.
pairs.hanzi: 她伸棒来，他没追棒头，只在布前挡了一下，林珂停住，又将棒慢慢抽回，两人都没抢着说谁成了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhèng xiǎng wèn néng bunéng zài lái , tā biàn zhǐ tā jiǎoxià , shuō fāngcái ràng de shìbushì yòu duō le , tā zhè cái kànjiàn zìjǐ de hòujiǎo yǐjīng dào le xiàn biān .
pairs.english: Tavi was just about to ask whether they could try again; she then pointed at his feet, asking whether he had yielded too much again just now, and only then did he see his own back foot had already reached the line.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维正想问能不能再来，她便指他脚下，说方才让的是不是又多了，他这才看见自己的后脚已经到了线边。

pairs.target: sòng yuǎn jiào tāmen jiāng zhè yíchù jìxià , jīnrì méi bǎ bàng tí kuài , yě méi bǎ tiě nálái tì tāmen bǔ méi shǒu hǎo de nà yíkuài .
pairs.english: Song Yuan told them to record that spot; today he had not sped up the stick, nor brought iron for them to make up for the patch they had not defended properly.
pairs.hanzi: 宋远叫他们将这一处记下，今日没把棒提快，也没把铁拿来替他们补没守好的那一块。

pairs.target: sàn le yǐhòu tǎ wéi tóng lín kē tái dèng , tā xiān zǒuchū mén , hūrán zài ménkǎn qián tíngzhù , tǎ wéi chàdiǎn bǎ lìngyìtóu sòngdào tā bèishàng .
pairs.english: After the session Tavi carried the stool with Lin Ke; she went out first, suddenly stopped before the threshold, and Tavi nearly sent the other end into her back.
pairs.hanzi: 散了以后塔维同林珂抬凳，她先走出门，忽然在门槛前停住，塔维差点把另一头送到她背上。

pairs.target: tā huítóu shuō zhèlǐ háiyǒu yídào , tā shuō kànjiàn le , huà cái chūlái , liǎng rén dōu xiào , sòng yuǎn cóng hòumiàn jiào tāmen zhēn kàn jiǎoxià , dèngzi hái děi yòng .
pairs.english: She turned back and said there was another one here; he said he saw it, and as soon as the words came out both of them laughed; Song Yuan called from behind for them to really watch their feet, since the stool still had to be used.
pairs.hanzi: 她回头说这里还有一道，他说看见了，话才出来，两人都笑，宋远从后面叫他们真看脚下，凳子还得用。
